# Closed class interface bridges

Owned Java fixtures cover a Signature-free child of a closed generic class that implements a fixed interface contract. The parent and child each retain the original checked Object bridge and typed String method with an opaque result.

Five frozen callers cover typed and erased invocation, a generic interface caller and special entry into both original bridge slots. A future subclass verifies virtual redispatch from each bridge. The 160 fresh JVM cases run twice and compare key, receiver and result identity, partial writes, callback order, early and late casts, null timing and exact runtime, Error and checked exception objects. Independent wrong programs qualify the observers.

Source and SDK profiles compile every emitted Java unit and require every original class and method, Code/access roles, Signature and Exceptions. Bridge projections retain their original unverified compiler-detail status. Code-preserving class Signature controls require the exact intended DEX annotation or SDK classfile before testing rejection.
